title: More than 1.5 million flock to see Busan's famous shark
caption:
A 3.5-meter shark has taken up residence in an artificial channel at Busan's North Port, drawing an estimated 1.5 million visitors over four weeks. Wildlife responders paused herding operations after boats and barrier nets caused excessive stress to the animal. Experts are now planning safer, low-impact ways to guide Bukang-i back to open water.

Source: Koreaherald - More than 1.5 million flock to see Busan's famous shark
